name: Speak with Thun'grim

meta.previous: Trial at the Field of Giants

summary: After the Trial at the Field of Giants, Thun'grim Firegaze calls warriors to his camp in the Barrens. The orc smith offers custom armor to those who have proved their valor, and sends them to gather materials for Brutal Armor.

sections.title: The Call of the Smith
sections.body: Word of the warriors’ trial reaches Thun'grim Firegaze after they prove their endurance and fighting skill to Ruga Ragetotem. His camp stands on a ridge east of the Crossroads. Thun'grim wants to forge them an exceptional suit of battle mail.

sections.title: A Master's Standard
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze reserves his forge for warriors who meet his high standard. He expects steel to match the spirit of the one who bears it. Reaching his camp means a warrior has moved beyond basic militia drills and can take on the hard work of gathering rare materials across Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze is a renowned orc blacksmith with a camp on a rocky ridge east of the Crossroads in the Barrens. He makes custom armor for Horde warriors who prove their valor through dangerous trials.

faq.q: Why does Ruga Ragetotem send me to him?
faq.answer: Ruga Ragetotem sends you to Thun'grim because you survived the silithid in the southern Barrens and have outgrown basic trials. The smith offers specialized armor in recognition of your service to the Horde.

faq.q: Where can I find Thun'grim's camp?
faq.answer: Thun'grim's camp is on the high bluffs east of the Crossroads in the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Thun'grim?
faq.answer: Speaking with Thun'grim begins the work of making Brutal Armor. You travel across distant lands to gather materials, including smoky iron ingots and iron bars, for a custom mail harness.

faq.q: Is this quest available to all classes?
faq.answer: No. Only Horde warriors may undertake this armor work.

faq.q: What trial was required before this meeting?
aliases: what did i do before this
faq.answer: Before meeting Thun'grim, you travel to the southern Barrens and complete the Trial at the Field of Giants. Gathering twitching silithid antennae proves your combat stamina.

angles.text: As a warrior, you have passed from novice fighter to recognized champion and earned custom-forged armor.
As a member of the Horde, you can count on its armorsmiths to equip its fiercest defenders for their deeds on the frontier.
As a blacksmith, you see Thun'grim Firegaze's traditional orcish belief that mastercrafted armor must be earned through martial trials, not bought with coin.
